description: Step 11, the only pause: freezes the write plan and pauses the run with a preview and its digest; Resume approves, stopping cancels. Then pilot locale first, the rest after: ETag-conditional overwrites with a journal and full read-back.

params.label: Pilot locale
params.description: Written and verified first, then the rest follows automatically. Empty: a 'Pilot locale:' line, else ro-ro when it has rows, else the first locale.

params.label: Approved digest
params.description: Normally empty. Alternative to Resume: 'Approved: <digest>' in the task of a new run of the same job.

portSummary: Reads prev, task, approval; produces job, report.
